title: Routes and networks: set 2
sourceNote: An original set written for this group. It is not a CAT previous-year set.
instructions: CAT marking: +3 right, -1 wrong multiple choice, 0 for a wrong type-in answer.
Type-in answers take a number only: no %, ₹ or units. Use a decimal, not a fraction.

groups.title: Water supply
groups.text:
Water leaves a reservoir W through two one-way pipes, to junctions J and K. From J, pipes run to town X, to town Y and to junction K. From K, pipes run to town Y and to town Z. There are no other pipes, and the junctions keep no water: whatever enters a junction leaves it.

In a day, X needs 30 megalitres (ML), Y needs 40 ML and Z needs 35 ML, and each town receives exactly what it needs. The pipe J-X carries 30 ML and the pipe K-Y carries 25 ML. The pipe W-J carries 15 ML more than the pipe W-K.

questions.text: How many ML a day flow through the pipe W-J?
How many ML a day flow through the pipe J-K?
Suppose the pipe J-K is shut. The towns still get exactly what they need, and the pipes J-X, J-Y and K-Y carry the same as before. How much must the pipe W-K carry?
In the original plan, what fraction of the water entering K comes from J?
